content: Tauri v2 (idle RAM ~30-60MB, bundle single-digit MB) is favored over Electron (idle ~150-300MB, 100MB+ installers) for new lightweight desktop apps in 2026, especially terminal/PTY-heavy tools; real comparable AI-terminal projects (Agents UI, Terax AI) chose Tauri specifically for Rust-native PTY management via portable-pty. Electron remains preferred when team is JS-only and needs maximum ecosystem maturity.
